rationale: Jenkins-pipeline-style scripts are top-level methods + calls (no class wrapper); both the method symbol and its call edges (echo, sh, deploy) must exist. GAD2 (M37 #599): script files use ONE sentinel, (script), for calls/instantiates/import refs — the old global/root split one file's graph across phantom nodes. Mixed class+script file: class members stay under the class; top-level statements stay under (script). Forbids: no relationship may originate from 'global' or 'root' — the retired script sentinels (GAD2).
